name: query_travel_plans
description: Looks up saved vacation travel plans in the TravelPlans DynamoDB table for a given destination city. Returns the city, the number of matching plans, and the list of plans. Use this to find existing itineraries before creating a new one.

TravelCity.description: Destination city to look up travel plans for, for example 'Paris'. Matching is by exact city name.

statusCode.description: HTTP-style status code: 200 on success, 400 if TravelCity is missing, 500 on a DynamoDB error.

body.description: JSON string with the keys travelCity (string), count (integer) and plans (array of travel plan items). On error it contains an 'error' message instead.
